name: starving-dogs-and-the-banquet
why: Opens on thousands of starving dogs fighting over one bowl with a banquet at their backs; the malaria row turns to skeletons beside its $7 billion, polio grows a beard, and the one patient who gets better is knocked over at the awards dinner over a crumb.

name: the-root-password
why: Opens on "every organization fighting a problem is fighting a symptom of the same upstream cause" as the camera climbs the river to the weapons factory; one missile rides down onto every village, the factory burns a forest to present a sprout, and the 1% valve turned the wrong way floods them all into bailing skeletons.

name: the-word-is-hobby
why: Opens on GM building tanks as cars go in and weapons come out under Uncle Sam's finger; the factories spin round in months while the nonprofit factory aimed at a dog bowl creaks an inch in decades, and its falling results line is a scarf a dog is knitting: "hobby".
